scope: Reviewed publication files and all reachable preserved public objects; local build/admin artifacts excluded from publication. Focused pre-audit, not a guarantee against every unknown identifying string.

build.archiver: The static-library archiver failure was an environment/toolchain invocation issue. Validation used an external Zig ar wrapper known at configure time; the wrapper is not part of the publication.
build.input_policy: No proprietary or uncertain input was imported to make the build pass.

tests.scope: Full CTest run for the second publication batch; public and synthetic tests only. External-input tests remain optional and are not required for this validation.
tests.python_cases_note: Case count retained from first-batch validation; the second-batch full CTest run passed all registered Python suites.

skipped.reason: External fixture intentionally excluded; executable successfully compiled.

checked: File and directory names, hidden tracked files
Personal paths and known developer identifier
Email attribution, secret token and key patterns
Credential assignments and embedded base64 media
Reachable commit metadata and historical blobs
SVG XML and embedded media/metadata indicators
limitations: Heuristic scanning cannot prove absence of unknown personal identifiers or obfuscated secrets.
This bounded candidate excludes unreviewed runtime and provenance-sensitive inputs.

history_boundary.baseline_object_set: Exactly the objects reachable from the public main ancestry
history_boundary.method: Independent public clone followed by approved file-content reads; identical blob hashes may arise naturally from identical contents.
